steps.command: cd /app && ls -la && wc -l input.csv expected.csv && head -5 input.csv && echo "---EXPECTED---" && head -5 expected.csv
cd /app && sed -n '6,20p' input.csv && echo "---EXP---" && sed -n '6,20p' expected.csv && echo "---TAIL---" && tail -5 input.csv && echo "---EXPTAIL---" && tail -5 expected.csv

cd /app && cp input.csv /tmp/input_test.csv && head -100 input.csv > /tmp/sm.csv && cp /tmp/sm.csv /tmp/sm2.csv && cat > /tmp/test.vim <<'EOF'
call setreg('a', ":s/\\s*,\\s*/,/g\r:s/^\\s*//\r:s/\\s*$//\r")
call setreg('b', ":s/\\([^,]*\\),\\([^,]*\\),\\([^,]*\\)/\\3;\\2;\\1;OK/\r")
call setreg('c', ":s/.*/\\U&/\r")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
wq
EOF
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/sm2.csv -S /tmp/test.vim; echo "exit=$?"; head -5 /tmp/sm2.csv; echo ---; head -5 expected.csv; diff <(cat /tmp/sm2.csv) <(head -100 expected.csv) && echo MATCH100
cd /app && time vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/input_test.csv -S /tmp/test.vim; echo "exit=$?"; cmp /tmp/input_test.csv expected.csv && echo FULLMATCH
